title: Traders are rushing to this hot crypto platform amid the war in Iran | Fortune
summary: Hyperliquid, a blockchain-based crypto platform, has become popular for trading oil derivatives, especially amid geopolitical tensions like the Iran war, offering 24/7 global markets unlike traditional stock exchanges.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights the increased demand for continuous markets due to geopolitical events, but also mentions the limitations and risks associated with trading in oil derivatives.
